playbooks.name: Agent Health Check
playbooks.goalTemplate: Check the health of all agents in the fleet, review recently failed tasks, and verify all provider keys are valid.

playbooks.name: Security Audit
playbooks.goalTemplate: Review the skill registry for any Untrusted or Review status skills. Check VirusTotal results and rotation dates of all provider keys.

onboarding.goal: Capture the agent fleet the user runs — the agents themselves, the model providers behind them, the skills they carry, and the projects they work — so the workspace reflects their real AI operation.
onboarding.framing: Act as a pragmatic AI ops lead. Tease out which agents are live, what models and providers power them, what each agent can do, and what work they're pointed at. Translate that into agents, providers, skills, and projects.

collect.what: The agents they run and what powers each
The model providers behind those agents and their budgets
The skills/capabilities each agent carries and how trusted they are
The projects the agents are working on

openingQuestions: Which agents are you running right now, and what's each one for?
What models and providers power them, and are there budget limits?
What skills do your agents carry, and which projects are they pointed at?
onboarding.doneWhen: The live agents exist with their model/provider, the providers are captured with budgets, key skills are catalogued, and agents are linked to active projects.
